RESPONSIBILITY AND COMPLIANCE STATEMENT

Dataset: Interview transcripts, maternal health practices study, 2024.
Depositor: Faculty of Anthropology.

The dataset contains transcripts of interviews with community health workers.
Participants were recruited in small rural settlements and several hold roles
held by only one person in their community, so identification remains possible
from occupational and geographic detail even after names are removed.

This material is sensitive. Ethics approval REC-2024-118 was granted by the
University Research Ethics Committee. The legal basis for processing is informed
consent. Third-party rights apply: participants retain rights over their
testimony. An embargo applies until 2027-01-01. Applicable jurisdiction: France.
